note: Scripture follows the Open Luganda Contemporary Bible (OLCB 2017, lug_bib — the lug text language_seed.py names). Every `mined` row was checked mechanically: its wording is a verbatim substring of the OLCB verse. `self_rendered` rows are Murray’s loose quotations, re-personed verses, merges, and places where the OLCB wording loses the word his argument turns on (each carries a `why`).

Murray’s archaic citations (1 Pet. i. 15, 16) are given as modern OLCB references (1 Peetero 1:15-16); citations Murray got wrong are kept as he wrote them in the body (see the PR’s “Found, not fixed” list) while the row here names the verse actually quoted.
Translated by per-chapter AI translators in one session; tag sequence identical to the English chapter by chapter. AI-translated; awaiting native review.
